verdict.rationale: GitLab's Duo Agent Platform lets users build custom flows that automate team processes, with user-defined triggers controlling when they run (gitlab-docs-36, gitlab-docs-59). Agents take on delegated work such as turning issues into merge requests, remediating vulnerabilities, refactoring and running security scans (gitlab-docs-1, gitlab-docs-47), and sessions report the status and execution data of those runs (gitlab-docs-37). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of background or scheduled execution semantics and trigger types, and independent or hands-on corroboration that flows run unattended in practice.
